policy: Tracked files are public; operator paths, container IDs/names, GPU UUIDs, active ports, private registry/volume names, and protected router state are omitted or generalized.

transformations: replace active loopback port with documented generic loopback port
derive bounded request lifecycle rows
remove timestamps, trace/span IDs, private paths, ports, and container command metadata
retain image/model/revision/containment values
remove container name/ID, private command, registry path, endpoint, and topology identity
retain GPU memory and host-memory aggregates
remove GPU UUIDs and process inventory
retain GPU memory, minimum host MemAvailable, and OOM delta
remove GPU UUIDs and process inventory
remove private paths, container, GPU UUID, port, registry digest, and watchdog implementation
correct six phases to nine HTTP requests while retaining original plan hash
remove protected absolute paths and private evidence locations
preserve request construction, gate semantics, token correlation, and uncertainty
retain exact official Ignis 0.8 source URLs and request-policy conclusions
omit private evidence paths, internal planning, and non-public operational context

entries.private_source: tool-choice-followup/plan-r4.json, stage-a-result.json, selection.json, selected-results.json, selected-full-native.json, selected-repeat-native.json, candidate-status-after.json, and resources-after-probes.json
entries.public_path: tool-choice-followup.json, plan.json, configuration.json, resource-summary.json, and summary.json
transformations: retain stage controls, exact pass counts, seed/mode selection, terminal engine IDs, captured HTTP-status boundary, request hashes, resource values, and private source hashes
omit active port, container identity, private registry/path, process inventory, raw response IDs/timestamps, and 400-line repeated fixture bodies
generalize live endpoint to the documented loopback boundary where referenced
retain only planned/submitted/completed counts and blocking prerequisite classes
remove task corpus, private routes, endpoints, paths, and operator identities

restoration_projection.private_source: trial/result.json plus tool-choice-followup/result.json and both phases' exact restoration identity, custody, readmission, smoke, resource, and failed-local-invocation receipts
transformations: remove container IDs/names, GPU UUID/order values, ports, private paths, mount sources, credentials, commands, and execution timestamps
retain exact public model/image/revision/recipe facts, custody-object hash equality, request counts, result, OOM status, and caveats
replace protected absolute paths with artifact labels
preserve target hashes, reviewer independence, gate status, residual risks, recommendation, human gate, and promoted=false
